instructions:
1. Anchor the middle of the band to a low point in front of you. Lie on a bench, feet flat on the floor, holding a handle in each hand with palms up and arms extended by your sides.
2. Bend your elbows to curl the handles halfway up until your forearms are parallel to the floor.
3. Keep your upper arms still against your sides.
4. Lower the handles with control back to the start.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back flat on the bench and do not arch your spine.
2. Move only at the elbows, keeping the upper arms fixed.
3. Control the band on the way down to keep tension on the biceps.
4. Exhale as you curl up and inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
2. Lift your right leg and extend it straight forward into a front kick.
3. Bring the right leg back and step it behind you into a lunge, lowering until your left thigh is parallel to the floor and your right knee nearly touches the floor.
4. Push through your left heel to stand back up.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your front knee in line with your ankle during the lunge.
2. Perform the kick with control, no swinging.
3. Keep your core braced to stay balanced.
4. Exhale on the kick, inhale as you lower into the lunge.

instructions:
1. Stand upright with feet hip-width apart. Step your right foot forward into a lunge, lowering until your right thigh is parallel to the floor and your left knee nearly touches the floor.
2. Raise your hips a few centimetres, then lower back down in a small controlled pulse.
3. Keep your core braced and balance steady throughout.
4. Push through your right heel to stand up, then switch legs.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your front knee in line with your ankle and over the midfoot.
2. Use a controlled motion, do not bounce.
3. Keep your torso upright and chest lifted.
4. Breathe steadily through the pulses.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, the middle of the band under your left foot. Hold the handles at shoulder height with elbows bent.
2. Step your right leg back into a reverse lunge, bending both knees until your right knee nears the floor.
3. Keep your left knee in line with your ankle and your torso upright.
4. Push through your left heel to return to standing, bringing the right leg forward.
5. Switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your front knee in line with your ankle.
2. Drive through the front heel to stand up.
3. Keep your core braced for balance.
4. Exhale as you push up, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, arms bent in front of your torso.
2. Step your right foot forward into a lunge, lowering until your right thigh is parallel to the floor and your left knee nears the floor.
3. Rotate your torso to the right, then to the left, keeping your hips stable.
4. Return your torso to centre and push through your right heel to stand up.
5. Switch legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your front knee in line with your ankle.
2. Rotate from the torso, keeping hips square and stable.
3. Keep your back straight and chest lifted.
4. Perform rotations with control, no jerking.
